description: Prepare closing a put, or any loan on a core with a put router, out of its own pledge: the pledge buys the repayment back and the rest comes back to the wallet, in one transaction (a loan of a lend asset against USDG, opened with put_open: it gains as the asset falls, and its loss stops at the USDG put in). Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

engine.description: The loan's core: its lend asset's (gage_capabilities lendAssets)

maxSlippageBps.description: Most the purchase may cost over its quote when it is sent, in bps; 50 when omitted

minBack.description: The least of the pledge you accept back, raw units (USDG: 6 decimals): the close is refused under it, and its transaction reverts under it

name: gage_prepare_put_close
title: Prepare: Close a put
